strings.sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash ewe pisekin angang GUI epwe iei usun suk ren omw ewe pisekin angang a fen fis.

• Non ewe SP Flash Tool, kopwe finata "Format Meinisin + Angei" seni ewe nenien angang.

• Kopwe tumunu pwe noumw we {device} epwe kouno me epwe kouno.
{hint}

Kopwe OK pwe kopwe poputani ewe SP Flash me tou seni ewe Pworaus CE.

• Non ewe Pisekin Angang SP, kopwe suki ewe Pworaus (ika Forata Meinisin + Angei ika mi namwot).

Iwe, kopwe äeä ewe USB pwe epwe poputä le äeä.

strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis a kan äeä ekkewe mineföön pisekin angang fän iten ekkewe chon fiti ewe Y1 (a äeä ekkewe mineföön board mi monomon usun chök 6.0, 7.0, me 8.0) mi chök atai ekkewe pisekin angang mi nom. Nge ewe mi ngaw seni ena, ar we website a awora zero kapasen ourour me zero tufichin fiti ekkewe firmware mi angang me nom pwe repwe chikar seni ew napanap mi brick. Ewe chon fori sefani CE me ewe prokramen Firmware non ewe Mwichefen ra angei ekkewe pisek: sia kan isoni meinisin ekkewe ROM mi nomw me nomw, sia pwisin annetata omw ewe pisekin angang mi siwin, me sia tumunu pwe noumw we chon fiti epwe angangoch.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Nupwen ekkewe chon fori ra mwokut, ewe mwichen aramas ra step up.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Amanaua ekkewe chon fiti mi tatakis: Ekkewe chekin tumun ra tumunu pwe ekkewe minefoon minefoon pisekin angang resapw atai ekkewe pisekin angang mi nom.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: Ekkewe ROM mi fen isoni: A unusen ionifengeni ekkewe pisekin angang mi akkomw fis seni ewe factory Innioasis a fen katowu.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Ekkewe pisekin angang mi fiti fitikoko: Ekkewe pisekin angang mi fiti fitikoko fan iten macOS, Linux, me Windows mi ussun chok.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Ekkewe pisekin angang: A pwisin kuna ewe board pwe kopwe angei ewe pachenong mi pung fansoun meinisin.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Kopwe tumunu om pisek seni ekkewe minen eppet mi monomon me ekkewe revision mi atai.
strings.support_story_2_body: Ach sipwe kutta ekkewe softwer Innioasis mi mumuta a kan wewe ngeni ach sipwe kutta ekkewe forum ren ekkewe ririin Google Drive mi fen wes, ekkewe kinikinin Baidu mi mano, me ekkewe zip mi monomon nge ese wor pisekin angang mi fitikoko. Aua fori ew nenien download mi nukuchar, mi pwisin finata ren wenechar mi SHA-256, ekkewe esinesin mi niwinsefan, me ekkewe install mi emwen non ew me ew kinikin. Om kewe asor ra wesewesen tumunu ekkewe download me hosting mi fori ei epwe tufich 24 awa iteiten ran, 365 ran iteiten ier.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Ese wor Google mi atai. Ese wor angangen ekiek. A chok angang won.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: CDN mi chék mwittir: A mwittir, me chék chéúfetál nge ese wor úkúkún chéúfetál are ekkewe link mi máló.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Ekkewe Esinesin mi Siwin: Kopwe angei esinesin non ewe fansoun ekkewe minefoon porousen mwichen aramas ika ekkewe fix ra fis.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Ekkewe Install mi Emwen: Ekkewe kapasen pesepes mi fatafatoch ra emwenikemi non iteiten button mi press.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Komuniti mi chommong fos: A unusen fiti fosun Merika, Fosun China, Fosun Tois, Fosun Spain, Fosun France & Fosun Japan.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Ekkewe pisekin angang mi tekia, mi affat pwe ka tongeni wesewesen apinukunuk won.
strings.support_story_3_body: Ewe softwer seni ewe factory stock a chok suki ewe asam ren met noumw we Y1 ika Y2 pisekin angang epwe tongeni fori. Am mwicheich a wato Rockbox, ekkewe pisekin angang mi mecheres, ekkewe codec mi fis fan iten aramas, me ekkewe itelap mi fis fan iten aramas ngeni manau. Sia kamo ekkewe sokopaten pisekin angang mi sokkono seni pocket pwe sipwe sotuni, siwini, me annetata iteiten install. Ewe Chon awenewena mi anisi a wesewesen moni ekkei kinikinin tes me a mwitir forutaan ekkewe pisekin angang mi fis fan iten aramas.
strings.support_story_3_headline: A suki unusen tufichin noumw we chon Innioasis.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox mi chék fis fán eú chék: Ewe minen álillis me ekkewe itelap mi ffér fán iten aramas ra kan ffér lón chék fitu seken.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Firmware ren Komuniti: Awenewenen battery, UI mi nimenimoch, me aninis ren codec mi fis ikenai.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Lab mi Achocho: Sia sotuni won ekkewe pisekin angang mi wesewesen fis me mwen ach sipwe fori och mettoch mi foruta.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Ese wor pisekin angang: 100% ese kamo, pisekin angang mi akkomw tumunu pwisin aramas nge ese wor ads ika fitikoko.
strings.support_story_3_lead: A uwei Rockbox, ekkewe pisekin angang mi mecheres, me ewe ngaseno seni ekkewe chon ausening.
strings.support_story_4_body: Lupwen eu kompenien pisekin angang a siwili ngeni ar we pisekin angang mwirin, ekkewe pisekin angang mi pin ra poutalo. Innioasis ese awora och aninis seni Linux, ese wor siwinin taropwe mi fatafatoch, me ese wor ew aan mi mecheres ne niwinsefan nupwen ew install ese fis. Chon awenewena a nom pokiten ekkewe chon aea mi pacheoch resapw nikitano ew minen urumot mi unusoch. 100% seni ekkewe aninis seni aramasen non neni epwe chok tonong non an epwe suk ei pisekin angang ngeni aramas meinisin.
strings.support_story_4_headline: Anisi kich ne fori met Innioasis rese fori.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Amanau & Awesi: Ewe ngaseno mi pwarata a fis ina mwo ika ekkewe pisek rese mochen boot.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Linux-Aewin-Klas Aninis: A unusen anisi MediaTek mi fifis won ekkewe nenien Linux.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Ekkewe taropwen siwin mi fatafatoch: Ekkewe taropwen pwarata mi titchik pwe kopwe sinei met sokkun siwin.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% Monien Komuniti: Iteiten kofi meinisin a tumunu pwe ewe nenien tumun epwe suk me ese kamo ngeni meinisin.
strings.support_story_4_lead: Ewe angangen tumunun firmware mi fis ren ewe mwichen aramas a tumunu pwe noum kewe pisek resapw nomw non ekkewe nenien rong.
